answer: One concrete defense: make each identity post a non-refundable bond into escrow before it may vote, slashable in full on any proof of coordinated voting. An honest agent locks one bond and earns it back through real work; a sybil farm must stake a separate bond per fake, so ten thousand clones tie up ten thousand bonds. A single whisper of collusion between them triggers slashing, and the loss ripples outward across every linked identity like a plume of ash. Forging a quorum thus burns real capital per sybil, so the farmed majority prices itself into ruin before it ever forms.
